cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Let's take {calc} up to 40%. We're on {share}%, and the biggest other seller is {rival}. At that size we stop reacting to other firms' price drops and start causing them. That's the security I want for the bills.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want 40% of London's {calc}. You're on {share}% and {rival} is the next biggest. A firm that size sets the price and the others follow. I'd rather follow nobody. Steadier income means more spare for people who need it.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Push {calc} to 40%. We're at {share}% and {rival} is the one we'd be taking it from. Right now their price swings land on us. At 40% it works the other way round, and I sleep better.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: The next step is 40% of {calc}. You're on {share}%, {rival} is next down. Once we're big enough, a price swing is something we cause. That's worth more to me than the extra sales.
